blocks.h2: Shower Repair Questions From McHenry Homeowners

items.q: Why does my showerhead spray in every direction?
items.preview: Mineral scale has blocked some nozzles.
items.answer: Hard water has left scale in the nozzles. Soak the head in vinegar or replace it. If the whole shower is weak, the cartridge may be scaled too.

items.q: Can you fix a dripping shower without opening the wall?
items.answer: Usually. Replacing a cartridge is done through the trim opening. A full valve replacement may need a small access panel.

items.q: Why does my shower leak into the ceiling below?
items.preview: A valve, drain or connection is leaking behind the wall.
items.answer: A leaking valve, a loose connection or a failing drain seal can drip into the ceiling below. We find the source and fix it.

items.q: Will a water softener help my shower?
items.preview: Yes. Less scale on heads, cartridges and glass.
items.answer: Yes. Softened water leaves far less scale on showerheads, cartridges and glass doors. See [water filtration](/mchenry/water-filtration-systems).

items.q: Can you install a handheld or rain showerhead?
items.answer: Yes. We install handheld, rain and multi-function showerheads and make sure the valve supplies enough flow. With hard water, choose a head with easy-to-clean nozzles.

items.q: How much does shower repair cost in McHenry?
items.preview: It depends on the valve and parts. You get a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the valve, the parts and access. We give you a flat-rate price before any work begins.
